component.name: Roue
component.summary: Drop a file, get the file you wanted

description.p: Roue converts files with a wheel of presets. Press a hotkey, drop a file on a slice, done. No dialogs, no editors, no uploads.

ul.li: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC to JPG, resize, compress, remove location and camera metadata
Video: MP4, GIF, WebM, under 10 MB or 25 MB for chat and email, mute
Audio: MP3, Opus, WAV, FLAC, even out loudness, extract the sound of a video
Documents: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Markdown to PDF, compress PDF, PDF pages to images or text
The wheel, opened at the pointer by Ctrl+Shift+right-clicking files in Files, by a hotkey (Super+Shift+D by default) for the files selected in Files, or by Shift-dragging any file on X11
"Convert with Roue…" in the right-click menu of Files, which opens the wheel at the pointer

description.p: The wheel shows the presets that fit your files best. Its last slice opens the full panel with every preset.

Results are saved next to the originals and never overwrite anything. Everything runs on your computer with FFmpeg, libvips, Ghostscript, Pandoc and LibreOffice. Add your own presets as small YAML files.

screenshot.caption: The wheel, opened from Files on a screen recording
The full panel, with every preset

description.p: First release: the wheel, the full panel, the Files menu, the command line and 27 built-in presets.
